evidence.title: Wireless
evidence.description: EDITORIAL REVIEW: **Science fiction guru Charles Stross "sizzles with ideas" (*Denver Post*) in his first major short story collection.** The Hugo Award-winning author of such groundbreaking and innovative novels as *Accelerando, Halting State*, and *Saturn's Children* delivers a rich selection of speculative fiction- including a novella original to this volume- brought together for the first time in one collection, showcasing the limitless imagination of one of the twenty-first century's most daring visionaries.

truth_claims.title: Wireless
truth_claims.author: Charles Stross
truth_claims.note: conf=0.95; Wireless (Ace Books, 2009, ISBN 9780441017195) is Charles Stross's first major short-story collection, not a novel in a series. UK/other editions carry the subtitle "The Essential Charles Stross". It contains nine pieces including the original novella "Palimpsest" and "Down on the Farm", a Laundry Files (Bob Howard) story — but the collection itself is a standalone volume, not a numbered entry in the Laundry Files or any other series.

truth_claims.note: conf=0.95; Verified: ISBN 9780441017195 = Wireless by Charles Stross, Ace Books, July 2009 (US 1st ed.). It is a standalone single-author short-story collection (contents: Missile Gap, Rogue Farm, A Colder War, MAXOS, Down on the Farm, Unwirer with Cory Doctorow, Snowball's Chance, Trunk and Disorderly, Palimpsest). UK Orbit edition adds the subtitle "The Essential Charles Stross" — a subtitle, not a series. Although one story ("Down on the Farm") belongs to the Laundry Files universe, the book itself is not part of that or any numbered series, so series = null. Proposed identification confirmed unchanged.
